description: Generate properly formatted HTML for Plane issues, comments, sprint reports, and pages. Plane requires HTML — plain text creates unformatted walls of text. Use this skill whenever writing content that goes into Plane via the API: issue descriptions, progress comments, sprint cycle reports, architecture pages. Triggers on: "write to plane", "create plane issue", "plane description", "plane comment", "sprint report", "plane page", "plane html", "render for plane".
